note: Copilot & AI #14. The demo copy is C:\demo\mcp-demo (the src folder including hidden .vscode, .github and .mcp.json, no tests). The Azure MCP Server runs read only and RG is created EMPTY (no cost). The GitHub MCP server authenticates through OAuth in the browser by the owner (no PAT); the throwaway repo mglab-mcp-demo is created and deleted by the owner's gh. Permission level stays Manual: never Allow all. Write must never run in the readonly-gotcha scene; if the agent claims it created something stop and check the repo. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: Push-Location C:\demo\mcp-demo; python -m mcpconf check .mcp.json; Pop-Location
# owner signs in (browser or device code) as the Azure owner account, off camera
az group create --name rg-mglab-copilot-ai-14 --location westeurope -o none
# owner signs in to GitHub with gh if not yet (gh auth login, off camera)

if (-not (gh repo view "$owner/mglab-mcp-demo" --json name 2>$null)) { gh repo create mglab-mcp-demo --private --add-readme; gh issue create --repo "$owner/mglab-mcp-demo" --title 'Renewal report shows wrong total' --body 'The total in the renewal report does not match the vendor list.'; gh issue create --repo "$owner/mglab-mcp-demo" --title 'Add notice deadline to the report' --body 'Show renewal date minus notice days for each vendor.' }

# manual (owner): open C:\demo\mcp-demo in VS Code, trust the workspace; Chat, Session Target Copilot, Chat: Open Customizations, MCP Servers: do the four servers appear? If not enable chat.mcp.workspaceRootConfig.enabled and say so; authenticate github (browser), start azure (first start downloads the npm package: do it before recording); dry-run the four prompts and start a fresh chat for each take

screens.name: mcp-servers
steps: Open C:\demo\mcp-demo (trusted); Chat view, new chat, Session Target Copilot
Chat: Open Customizations, MCP Servers: show microsoftLearn, azure, github and contosoVendors with their state and tool counts
Authenticate github in the browser (off camera if needed); start azure (after az login)
Briefly show the server output view for contosoVendors
mask: GitHub account name and avatar (Status Bar, Copilot dashboard, account menu)
Azure subscription id and tenant id
Windows user name in any path

screens.name: learn-call
steps: Prompt: Use the Microsoft Learn MCP tools to find the official documentation for the Kusto Query Language where operator. Summarize its syntax and link to the documentation. Do not change files.
Approve the tool when asked; expand the tool call: tool name microsoft_docs_search (or fetch), the query and the result
Show the final answer with its link; if the answer is plausible but there was no tool call say so (it does not count)
mask: GitHub account name and avatar (Status Bar, Copilot dashboard, account menu)

screens.name: vendors-call
steps: Same chat or a new one, Agent
Prompt: Which Contoso vendors have a notice deadline that has already passed, and what is the total yearly cost of the vendors renewing in the next 400 days? Use today's date.
Expand the tool calls list_renewals and total_cost with their arguments and JSON results
Compare the final answer with the tool output on screen
mask: GitHub account name and avatar (Status Bar, Copilot dashboard, account menu)

screens.name: azure-github
steps: After az login (subscription: the lab pay-as-you-go one, rg-mglab-copilot-ai-14 created empty): new chat, Agent
Prompt 1: List my Azure resource groups. Show the tool approval prompt with its options and the result (it must include rg-mglab-copilot-ai-14)
Prompt 2: List the open issues in mglab-mcp-demo and summarise them (two seeded issues)
mask: Azure subscription id, tenant id and UPN
GitHub account name and avatar (Status Bar, Copilot dashboard, account menu)

screens.name: readonly
steps: Prompt: Create an issue titled mcp write test in mglab-mcp-demo.
Record what the agent does and open the server's tool list (no issue write tool expected)

Show the one line in .mcp.json that makes the server read only; temporarily point the same server at https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ and show the write tools appearing in the tool list; do NOT run a write; restore the file afterwards
mask: GitHub account name and avatar (Status Bar, Copilot dashboard, account menu)

teardown: $owner = gh api user --jq .login; gh repo delete "$owner/mglab-mcp-demo" --yes   # needs the delete_repo scope: gh auth refresh -s delete_repo

# manual (owner): VS Code, MCP: Reset Trust, stop the servers; revoke the GitHub OAuth authorization for VS Code MCP (GitHub Settings, Applications) if it was only for the recording; confirm in the Azure cost view that nothing was billed
